description: The standing public record of this service's own calls — free, no key. Every US trading day at 11:00 ET the day-session read for ES=F, NQ=F and QQQ is snapshotted verbatim; after the close each row is scored on whether a new session high or low actually printed after the read. Ties score against the model, days with no live read stay visible as gaps, and no row is ever edited. Recording began 2026-08-25. Use this to verify the claims before trusting any read.

limit.description: Rows to return, newest first. Default 30.
